Batch 7 scaffold is authored in [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-31a-batch-7.pages.json), [coverage harvest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-31a-batch-7.coverage.json), and [notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-31a-batch-7.notes.md).

It contains 29 A items and 4 dependency-safe B examples, with explicit `deps` arrays throughout. The harvest records 50 source results from EGNO and Meusburger, including the correction that the semisimple-unit claim is EGNO Theorem 4.3.8—not Theorem 4.3.1. [EGNO](https://math.mit.edu/~etingof/egnobookfinal.pdf), [Meusburger’s notes](https://www.math.fau.de/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Tensor-Categories.pdf)

Batch-local manifest, coverage, source-fetch, content-policy, plan, JSON, and whitespace checks pass. The only outstanding operational check is URL liveness: the local `curl` worker cannot resolve either source host, despite both PDFs being successfully opened and read through the document browser. A network-capable rerun of that check is needed.
